title: Config schema snapshot (<configDir>/.schema/<file>.json), format 1
description: Written by Kiln.Api Config.Register (and by kiln-emf for EMF settings) whenever a mod registers a config: the config's schema without values, so the launcher can edit the file offline. Path: <configDir>/.schema/ + the config file's path relative to configDir with its extension replaced by .json (my-mod.json -> .schema/my-mod.json; emf/beastmaster.ini -> .schema/emf/beastmaster.json). The launcher caches snapshots per mod version (schema-cache/). Entry shape = the admin op config_get's entries minus value/fileValue/fromServer.

source.description: kiln: Kiln.Api Config (JSONC values file); emf: an EMF mod's settings (INI values file).

file.description: The values file, relative to configDir.

id.description: Config id: <modid>[-<name>][-server|-client] for Kiln, the EMF mod id for EMF.

kiln.description: Kiln version that wrote the snapshot.

type.description: Kiln ConfigValueKind; duration values are strings like "90s", "5m", "1h30m".

default.description: The default value as JSON (null allowed).
